header: Conﬁguring permissions for automatic semantic enrichment
content:
Before creating an index with automatic semantic enrichment, you need to conﬁgure the required
permissions. This section explains the permissions needed for diﬀerent index operations and
how to set them up for both AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) and ﬁne-grained access
control scenarios.
